changelog:
What changed in v2.6.0:

Added data handling notice — explicit disclosure that text is transmitted to remote API over HTTPS and immediately discarded after sanitization
Added /.well-known/x402.json discovery endpoint for autonomous x402 agent payment flow
Added /preflight endpoint with billing_model, price_per_unit, and bundle_description for buyer-agent wallet authorization
Added /policy endpoint returning SHA-256 hash of service terms for agent verification before payment
Added HEAD method support to /.well-known/x402 for agent preflight checks
Added 10 discovery aliases — /agents.txt, /mcp.json, /.well-known/agents.json, /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json and more
Added /trustboost-pii-sanitizer alias for ClawHub skill agents
Added /.well-known/glama.json for Glama marketplace indexing
Added billing_model transparency field to /preflight
Extended llms.txt with complete payment flow example and Python copy-paste code
Added AGENTS.md — Linux Foundation standard for agent interaction
Added .cursor/rules for automatic PII sanitization in Cursor workflows
Added plugin.json and manifest.json for Claude Code plugin directory
8 languages supported: EN, ES-LATAM, PT-BR, DE, JA, FR, IT, KO
